patch.objective: Using diagnostic tools to investigate an application issue: Cloud Trace, Cloud Profiler, Query Insights, index advisor

sources.cite: Google Cloud, Associate Cloud Engineer exam guide (PDF linked from the certification page): setting up a cloud solution environment (~20%), planning and implementing a cloud solution (~30%), ensuring the successful operation of a cloud solution (~30%), configuring access and security (~20%)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-18. Four sections with the weights above match the course seed's units; subsections 3.3 'Managing networking resources' and 4.2 'Managing service accounts'; the guide names CMEK (3.2), Query Insights (3.4) and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (2.1, 3.1). The HTML page at cloud.google.com/certification/guides/cloud-engineer/ still shows an older five-section outline (Cloud Functions, Cloud Run for Anthos); the PDF is the current guide.

sources.cite: PostgreSQL 18 documentation, CREATE INDEX (manual page, as packaged)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 'a standard index build locks out writes (but not reads) on the table until it's done'; with CONCURRENTLY 'PostgreSQL will build the index without taking any locks that prevent concurrent inserts, updates, or deletes', it 'takes significantly longer', 'CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot' run in a transaction block, and a failure leaves an INVALID index. Cloud SQL Query Insights and the pg_stat_statements output are the author's scenario (Query Insights' features to verify against the Cloud SQL documentation).
